appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Cooling Water Temperature Compliance'.

A blue line connects black circular data points for each year from 2005 to 2014.
Each data point has a temperature value labeled directly above it in degrees Celsius.

The data point for 2014 is at 10.1°C and is the lowest point on the chart.
